description: E1 regression (tail race at shutdown, deterministic variant): at the LAST onTurnEnd (turn 3) only ~142 tokens exist — below the 150-token chunk threshold, so NO chunk is ever emitted during the loop. Turn 4 (~66 tokens, carries the facts) is appended WITHOUT onTurnEnd (noPumpLastTurns: 1) and the session shuts down immediately: total 208 >= 150, so the ONLY path that can observe the facts is the shutdown final pump (E1 fix: 'history GREW since the last pump -> one final pump' in shutdown()). Before the fix this case loses 100% of its facts (zero observations); after the fix both must land in memory. Regresses: observations accumulated after the final onTurnEnd surviving to memory at graceful shutdown.
